prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「海洋」？
explanation: ocean 的意思是海洋。

prompt: 「voyage」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: voyage 的意思是航行。

prompt: 选择表示「港口」的单词。
explanation: 表示港口的单词是 harbour。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「潮汐」？
explanation: tide 的意思是潮汐。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「水手」？
explanation: sailor 的意思是水手。

prompt: 「compass」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: compass 的意思是罗盘。

prompt: 选择表示「暴风雨」的单词。
explanation: 表示暴风雨的单词是 storm。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「锚」？
explanation: anchor 的意思是锚。

prompt: 虽然有暴风雨，水手还是起航了。哪一句正确？

choices.text: Although there was a storm, but the sailors set out
Although there was a storm, the sailors set out
Although a storm, the sailors set out
Despite although the storm, sailors set

explanation: although 不和 but 连用。
verify: "Although there was a storm, the sailors set out"

prompt: While the tide was high, ___ . 表示尽管潮水很高仍留在港内，横线处填哪一个？

choices.text: but the ship stayed in the harbour
so the ship stayed and although
the ship stayed in the harbour

explanation: while 这里表示让步，主句直接写 the ship stayed，不加 but。

prompt: 哪一句用 while 表示对比？

choices.text: While the compass worked, but the radio failed
The compass worked while but the radio
The compass worked, while the radio failed

explanation: while 连接两件相反的事，表示对比。
verify: "The compass worked, while the radio failed"

prompt: although 和 but 可以怎样用？

choices.text: 用了 although 就不要再加 but
but 要放在 although 前面

explanation: although 已经表示转折，不再加 but。
verify: "用了 although 就不要再加 but"

prompt: 他们早起航，以便赶上潮水。哪一句正确？

choices.text: They left early so that they can caught the tide
They left early in case they could catch the tide as their purpose only
They left early so that they could catch the tide
So that they left early catch the tide

explanation: so that 加 could catch 表示目的。
verify: "They left early so that they could catch the tide"

prompt: Take a compass ___ you get lost. 表示以防迷路，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: in case 表示以防万一。so that 表示为了达到某个目的。

prompt: 哪一句是目的而不是以防万一？

choices.text: She checked the anchor so that the ship would not drift
She checked the anchor in case the ship drifted
Although she checked the anchor, it held
While she checked the anchor, he watched

explanation: so that the ship would not drift 是目的。in case 是防备漂移真的发生。
verify: "She checked the anchor so that the ship would not drift"

prompt: in case 引导的从句主要表达什么？

choices.text: 和 although 相同的让步

explanation: in case 表示以防万一。

prompt: 想说虽然有暴风雨仍要起航，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Although there is a storm, but we will set out
Despite although the storm we set
Although there is a storm, we will set out

explanation: although 不和 but 连用。
verify: "Although there is a storm, we will set out"

prompt: 想说早走是为了赶上潮水，哪一句合适？

choices.text: We leave early so that we can catch the tide
We leave early in case we can catch the tide
So that we leave early catch
We leave early although we can catch the tide

explanation: so that 表示目的。
verify: "We leave early so that we can catch the tide"

prompt: 想提醒带上罗盘以防迷路，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Take a compass so that you get lost
Take a compass in case you get lost
Take a compass although you get lost
In case take a compass you lost

explanation: in case you get lost 表示以防迷路。
verify: "Take a compass in case you get lost"

prompt: 想对比罗盘还能用、无线电坏了，哪一句合适？

choices.text: The compass works, while but the radio has failed
While the compass works but the radio
The compass works, while the radio has failed
The compass works although but the radio failed

explanation: while 可以表示对比，不加 but。
verify: "The compass works, while the radio has failed"

prompt: Although the storm was close, the sailors left harbour early so that they could catch the tide. They took a compass in case the radio failed. The anchor held, while the small boat did not. 暴风雨临近时，水手做了什么？
explanation: Although the storm was close, the sailors left。

prompt: Although the storm was close, the sailors left harbour early so that they could catch the tide. They took a compass in case the radio failed. The anchor held, while the small boat did not. 他们为什么早离开？
explanation: so that they could catch the tide 是目的。

prompt: Although the storm was close, the sailors left harbour early so that they could catch the tide. They took a compass in case the radio failed. The anchor held, while the small boat did not. 带罗盘是为了什么？
explanation: in case the radio failed。

prompt: Although the storm was close, the sailors left harbour early so that they could catch the tide. They took a compass in case the radio failed. The anchor held, while the small boat did not. while 对比的是哪两件事？
explanation: The anchor held, while the small boat did not。

prompt: 要点：尽管暴风雨仍离港、早走为了赶潮、带罗盘以防无线电失灵。哪一句三个要点都有？

choices.text: Although a storm was close they left so that they could catch the tide, and they took a compass in case the radio failed

explanation: 三个要点都要出现。
verify: "Although a storm was close they left so that they could catch the tide, and they took a compass in case the radio failed"

prompt: 备忘里表示锚稳住了而小船没有，哪一句正确？

choices.text: The anchor held, while but the small boat did not
Although the anchor held, but the boat did not
The anchor held, while the small boat did not
While the anchor held but the boat

explanation: while 表示对比，不加 but。
verify: "The anchor held, while the small boat did not"

prompt: 哪一句适合作为备忘的第一句？

choices.text: Checking the tide before the voyage
Check the tide before the voyage starting
Check the tide before the voyage

explanation: 备忘可以先写要检查的事。

prompt: 表示早起以便看清航线，哪一句正确？

choices.text: Start early so that you can see the route
Start early in case you can see the route as your only purpose
Start early although you can see the route
So that start early you see

explanation: so that you can see 是目的。
verify: "Start early so that you can see the route"
